verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The identity is stated in both normalisations. In the physical one, physical_signed_cross_covariance states B(W_{0,phys}^as, L_phys^as σ) = σ, with the left side written exactly as the symmetrised cross term of (7.23): the double average (angular mean in θ, Haar mean in Y) of w_r v_tan + v_r w_tan. In the chart normalisation, requested_cross_tail states meanBar (actualCross …) n x = requestedStress … n x i, where actualCross is the symmetric covariance of actualPrimaryField and actualSignedField (ActualSignedMeanBinding.lean:332-343), both assembled from the tangentBlock of the display eq-p085-3 and hence Q^A-scaled by primary_mode_view; the hypothesis n ≥ N+1 is where the squared physical partition sums to one (partitionFactor_eq_one), the tail on which the paper's η_β² sum is one. Passing between the two forms is multiplication by Q^{2A} and bilinearity of B, i.e. the rescaling of eq-p085-3; within the SignedCovariance module alone that rescaling is not performed, the equivalent cancellation being packaged into physical_signed_scale instead. One further encoding point: the Lean's sum runs over all labels U = (ℓ,a) with each label carrying its own Q, the chart dependence being inside physicalOuter and chartStress, so the identity is the assembled one rather than a per-chart one.
